notes: Keep a story only if its headline or summary matches one of the ticker's aliases (case-insensitive, whole-word). Tickers in no_bare_ticker must never be matched on the bare ticker. Match $TICKER or (TICKER) forms are fine for those. Prefer stories whose Finnhub 'related' field equals the ticker but still apply the name check, since Finnhub tags roundup articles with many tickers.
summary_boilerplate_patterns: (?i)for questions about this article or underlying research.*$
(?i)^looking for stock market analysis and research.*$
summary_rules: After stripping, hide the summary if it is empty, under 20 characters, or identical to the headline.
caveats: Aliases were written by hand and haven't been tested against a full week of news. Watch Apple (fruit or produce stories are rare in finance feeds, but possible), Delta (the variant or other Deltas), Sphere (generic word, which is why only multi-word forms are listed), Unity (generic word, so only company forms are listed), and Ford (matches people named Ford; 'Ford Motor' is safest).
